subtitle: Mushroom foraging and the outdoors
course_body: The foraging course is now open for sign ups! Come along with an experienced forager into the woods to learn all about edible and poisonous mushrooms.
course_details_logistics: We gather at 10:00 at Svampskogen's store at Mitt Möllan, and then we drive to the forest. We will spend the day there until approximately 16:00 and then return by 17:00.
course_bring_1: Appropriate clothing (waterproof pants and shoes in particular are recommended)
course_cost: The cost for the course is 600 kronor, pay by Swish at 1236504575 with the message "svampkurs <name(s)>". If you have a car and can drive yourself the price is 500 kronor. Remember that you can use friskvårdsbidrag if you have it! If you don't have Swish you can come pay by card in the store, please make note of this in the form if you do.
course_questions: If you have any questions you can reach me at Facebook/Instagram or kristian@svampskogen.com.
course_park_body: Malmö's parks are full of wonderful and uncommon mushrooms. Take the chance to learn all about edible and poisonous mushrooms from an experienced forager.
course_park_booking_note: Prefer not to sign up? You can also just come along to one of the meeting points below.
course_park_date_1: Saturday 19 September at 9:45: Tallriken in Pildammsparken.
course_park_date_2: Sunday 20 September at 9:45: the Pegasus statue (Linnéplatsen) in Slottsparken.
course_park_date_3: Monday and Tuesday we gather at 17:30 instead, at the same respective spots.
course_park_practical: The tour will be about an hour and is pay-what-you-want. I accept Swish and card payments after the tour concludes.
about_p1: Svampskogen is a specialty store for anyone who loves nature and the world of mushrooms, located in Mitt Möllan in Malmö. I'm Kristian Berg, and I want to create a place where both seasoned foragers and curious beginners feel at home.
about_p2: You'll find everything from foraging knives, baskets, and growing kits to outdoor gear like firesteels, campfire cups, and grill accessories. I also exhibit art by local artists inspired by nature and mushrooms.
about_p3: Whether you're looking for a gift, a new hobby, or quality gear, you're welcome to come in!
suppliers_p1: I'm actively looking to collaborate with Scandinavian producers, makers, and artists whose products and work fit the profile of Svampskogen. I'm happy to get in touch!
store_coming_soon: The online store is coming soon.

returns_intro: This page covers your right of withdrawal, how to make a complaint, and the terms that apply to a purchase from Svampskogen.
returns_withdrawal_p1: Under Swedish law (distansavtalslagen), you have the right to cancel your purchase within 14 days without giving any reason.
returns_withdrawal_p2: The withdrawal period expires 14 days after the day you (or someone you've designated) took possession of the goods, for example by collecting them from a pickup point. If an order contains several items delivered separately, the period is counted from the day you received the last item.
returns_withdrawal_p3: The right of withdrawal does not apply to goods made to your specifications or clearly personalized, such as custom-made products.
returns_how_heading: How to exercise your right of withdrawal
returns_how_p1: Before the withdrawal period expires, let us know that you're cancelling your purchase, for example by emailing kristian@svampskogen.com. You're welcome to use the withdrawal form below, but it isn't required — a clear statement is enough.
returns_how_p2: The goods must be sent back to us without undue delay, and no later than 14 days after you notified us of the cancellation. You are responsible for the cost of return shipping.
returns_how_p3: We'll refund what you paid, including the standard shipping cost, within 14 days of receiving the returned goods or proof that they've been sent back. Refunds are made using the same payment method you used for the purchase. If the goods' value has decreased because they were handled more than necessary to establish their nature, properties, and function, we may deduct the corresponding decrease in value.

returns_complaint_p1: If an item is faulty, Swedish consumer law (konsumentköplagen) gives you the right to file a complaint within three years of purchase. Contact us at kristian@svampskogen.com as soon as possible after noticing the fault and describe what's wrong.
returns_complaint_p2: If your complaint is approved, you're entitled to a repair, replacement, price reduction, or to cancel the purchase, plus reimbursement of return shipping. We'll respond within a reasonable time of receiving your complaint.
returns_purchase_p1: Payment is made by card, Swish, or Klarna through our payment provider Stripe. The amount is charged once your order is approved.
returns_purchase_p2: We deliver with PostNord to addresses in Sweden. Shipping cost and estimated delivery time are shown before you complete your purchase.
returns_purchase_p3: Your purchase becomes binding once you've completed the order and payment has been approved, confirmed by an order confirmation sent to your email. We reserve the right for items to sell out and for errors in pricing or product information.
returns_dispute_heading: If we can't resolve a dispute
returns_dispute_p1: If we can't resolve a dispute between us, you can turn to the National Board for Consumer Disputes (Allmänna reklamationsnämnden, ARN), Box 174, 101 23 Stockholm. You can also use the European Commission's online dispute resolution platform.
